title: Orphaned .cam-implement-blocked marker survives in-cycle recovery + ship (false boot blocker)
description: The durable .cam-implement-blocked marker (src/supervisor/implement-blocked-marker.ts) is written on every 'blocked' terminal of runSupervisor but removed ONLY by removeImplementBlockedMarker on the next re-armed implement dispatch for the SAME issue (sidecar.ts, issueId-matched). When a blocked terminal is followed by in-cycle recovery (the worker retries -> DONE) and the issue then ships, no re-armed dispatch ever occurs, so the marker is never cleared: it orphans permanently and false-alarms as an '⚠ implement blocked: issue #<id>' opening blocker at EVERY future orchestrator boot, degrading the boot-blocker signal (cry-wolf). Observed live 2026-07-18: CAM-346's US-001 hit a transient 'finalize aborted, gates failed: tests failed' terminal (marker written, consecutiveCount 1), the retry recovered to DONE, review CLEAN, PR #283 merged and shipped v0.207.0 -- yet .claude/.cam-implement-blocked.json (issueId 346) remained on disk. Fix: also remove the marker on any successful terminal for the issue (complete/DONE terminal in loop.ts, and/or the ship/close-on-main path), not only on re-arm; mirror how the ship-stalled marker is consumed once the PR merges. Same file also has the ship-stalled and plan-escalation marker precedents to mirror. Grounded 2026-07-18.
